raft.idle: Ready to propose a new entry.
raft.appended: The leader has appended entry 1 in the current term. It is not committed yet.
raft.acknowledged: Follower A has acknowledged entry 1. With the leader, a majority of 2/3 has replicated it.
raft.committed: The leader advances commitIndex to 1, then notifies followers. Follower B catches up.
raft.assumptions: Conceptual model: fixed leader, one current-term entry, three healthy nodes. Elections, disk persistence, retries, and network failures are omitted. This is not a running HyperRaft cluster.

aboutPage.title:
An AI-native reliability
engineering company.
aboutPage.metaDescription: Smartscity combines AI agents and expert reliability engineering methods, with a strategy spanning AI engineering, independent assessment and engineering products.
aboutPage.intro: Smartscity — Biying Technology — combines AI agents with expert engineering methods to help enterprise teams identify risks, verify system reliability and define remediation that can be checked against clear acceptance criteria.
aboutPage.whoText: Our mission is to bring expert reliability engineering into requirements, architecture, development, testing, releases, operations and recovery. We aim to use AI to scale that expertise and make engineering methods continuous and automated.
aboutPage.whoText2: Our strategy has three pillars: AI reliability engineering, independent research and professional assessment, and reliability engineering products. Engineering judgments must be supported by evidence and lead to actionable remediation and verifiable acceptance. Specific service scope and available product capabilities are described in the corresponding guides and project pages.

aboutPage.openSourceText: Share source and documentation where projects are public, welcome specific questions, and keep claims connected to evidence.

privacyExtra.metaDescription: How the Smartscity website uses local storage, handles demonstrations and contact links, and relies on hosting providers.

sections.title: Website features and local storage
sections.text: The website application does not set advertising or analytics cookies. It stores only your selected color theme in browser local storage. You can remove that preference through your browser settings. Interactive examples keep sample inputs in page memory; they are not saved or sent to a server.

sections.title: Hosting and external services
sections.text: The site is hosted on Cloudflare and uses its Web Analytics script to report page visits and performance. Reports include page paths, referring websites, country or region, browser and device categories. Cloudflare Web Analytics does not use cookies or local storage to track visitors across websites. Hosting and security services may separately process request information, such as IP addresses, to deliver and protect the site. The site has no embedded external forms or videos; apart from Cloudflare analytics, assets are served locally or supplied by your device.

sections.title: Email and public project links
sections.text: The Contact page prepares an email draft locally and can copy it to your clipboard when you choose. It does not submit or store your message. A mailto link opens your email application; sending a message is your separate action. If you email us, your message and the contact information you choose to provide reach the receiving mailbox. GitHub links take you to GitHub, where its own privacy policy applies. Do not post confidential information in public issues.

strategyHouse.title: A shared foundation. Three pillars.
strategyHouse.intro: Our strategy connects expert reliability engineering, independent assessment and engineering products across the software lifecycle.
strategyHouse.alt: Smartscity strategy house: mission and vision above three capability pillars, supported by shared methods and long-term assets.
strategyHouse.caption: Our strategic direction. Specific service scope and product availability are described in the corresponding guides and project pages.
strategyHouse.mission: Bring expert reliability engineering across the software lifecycle, scaled, sustained and automated through AI.
strategyHouse.vision: Become an AI-native reliability engineering company serving enterprises worldwide: identify risks early, continuously verify reliability and close the engineering governance loop with evidence.

pillars.title: AI reliability engineering
pillars.text: Scale analysis and engineering execution, making expert methods repeatable. Outputs include risk analysis, verification plans, runtime analysis and remediation reassessment.

pillars.title: Independent research and professional assessment
pillars.text: Provide reviewable engineering judgments and actionable remediation plans through professional reports, experiments, evidence, remediation roadmaps and follow-up acceptance.

pillars.title: Reliability engineering products
pillars.text: Embed effective methods in engineering systems and reduce repeated delivery and governance costs through engineering software, verification tools and reusable method assets.

strategyHouse.method: Architecture, business, development and operational reliability, spanning requirements, architecture, development, testing, releases, operations and incident recovery.
strategyHouse.principles: Independent judgment · Reviewable evidence · Verifiable remediation · Reusable methods
strategyHouse.delivery: Professional assessments · Specialist engineering services · Continuous verification services · Engineering software
